channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Building 113/114/115/116 (Union Iron Works Machine Shop)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Building 113/114/115/116 (Union Iron Works Machine Shop) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 113/114/115/116 (Union Iron Works Machine Shop): The map notes no longer call 21st St a not-yet-built street, since DataSF lists it as an active street and the Port says its improvements were built from 2019 and accepted in 2024. They now say the 1885 and 1886 brick structures are not named 'Machine Shop' and 'Foundry' in the planning packet, and give the packet's metal-additions wording as written. They also say the old Assessor lot 4111004 was retired in 2018, replace two bare-homepage source links, and date the Port's January 2019 update to its Jan 4 memo.
item.description: The map notes no longer call 21st St a not-yet-built street, since DataSF lists it as an active street and the Port says its improvements were built from 2019 and accepted in 2024.
